research_rationale:
EO 13646 (Establishing the President's Advisory Council on Financial Capability for Young Americans; 78 FR 39159) was read in full from the held Federal Register original. It establishes an advisory Council within the Department of the Treasury and, in section 6, ends it 2 years after the order's date unless the President extends it. No extension is held, so every clause ended by the order's own terms on June 25, 2015, and the whole order has no operative force on 2026-10-14. The U.S. Code lead (CURRENT:EO:13646#0, 20 U.S.C. 9701 note) only prints the order as a note with no ending statement; a printed note does not show the Council continuing, and I did not treat it as a current predicate. The catalog observation for EO 13646 has an empty note, which establishes nothing about current effect; the status decision records 'no' on the order's own terms and the bounded searches (U.S. Code through 2026-10-09, eCFR as of 2026-10-14, Federal Register catalog and saved order texts), which found no later instrument acting on EO 13646.
